title: Machine that appends a bit
statement: For each bit $b$, define a finite Turing machine with no work tapes, a single state, and that state as its initial state. When it reads a symbol, it moves the input head one step to the right, outputs the symbol, and remains in the state; when it reads a blank, it outputs $b$ and halts.
